_comment: TEMPLATE for the PRIVATE part of autoMode (docs/PROFILES.md). scripts/permission-rollout.py fills <owners> from --owners and <dev-dirs> from --dev-dirs; real owner names and paths never live in this public repository. Owners: only the user's own account and organizations they administer (`gh api user/memberships/orgs`). Dev dirs: explicit personal development roots, never the home directory, a filesystem root or a system path. There is no documented 'trusted local directory' slot, so this is free-form prose; the file-access grant itself is permissions.additionalDirectories. Do not add arbitrary cloud projects, buckets, domains or third-party owners.

environment: **Trusted GitHub owners (supersedes the default Organization entry)**: <owners> are the user's own account and organizations they administer.

**Personal source-control scope (supersedes the default Source control entry above)**: besides the session's repository and its remotes, repositories owned by <owners> are internal. Fetch, pull, pushes to the user's own branches, and pull-request creation and review are ordinary source-control work on them, whatever the session's working directory (it may not be a git repository). Merging follows the Authorized pull request merge entry, not this one. Repository visibility still follows the Repository visibility entry. Any other owner is external.

**Personal development machine (the starting directory is not the trust boundary)**: this is the user's personal Mac, not a corporate workstation. Git repositories and worktrees under <dev-dirs> (existing and future), and the local build, test and lint processes run in them, are trusted development context whichever of them a session started in; moving between them is not scope escalation. Trust is for development work only: it does not cover credential or key files (~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud, keychains, .env files holding secrets), the agent's own configuration (.claude/ settings, hooks, skills and commands, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), git hooks and git config (.git/hooks, .git/config), shell startup files, system-protected paths, production resources, or sending private file contents to external services.
allow: **Cross-repository personal development**: within <dev-dirs>, reading and searching source, read-only git commands, builds, tests, linters, creating a worktree, and editing source files for the task in a repository other than the one the session started in are in scope for the user's task and are not 'wandering into other repos'. This exception does not apply to credential or key files, .env files, .claude/ settings, hooks, skills or commands, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, .git/hooks or .git/config, shell startup files, system paths, irreversible deletion, force-removing a worktree another session owns, or uploading file contents to an external destination.
